worst_moment: "What happens to each term inside the brackets when you square them?" - a vague opener whose wording even suggests squaring each term, the very misconception on the page.
best_moment: "When you square (x + 3), you multiply it by itself. That means you get x times x, plus x times 3, plus 3 times x, plus 3 times 3. Can you see how the 6x comes from adding those middle terms?" - answers the why clearly and hands the insight back.
